Sumiklab ang sunog sa residential area sa Conchita Street, Brgy. 127, Pasay City, Biyernes ng gabi, October 17. Kasalukuyang nasa ikatlong alarma ang sunog. 

Patuloy na inaapula ng mga bombero ang apoy. Tinutukoy pa rin ang sanhi nito. | via @AllisonCoABSCBN https://t.co/XaYzpq2fdR

data.english_translation: Fire broke out in the residential area of Conchita Street, Brgy. 127, Pasay City, Friday night, Octtober 17. Fires are currently on the third alarm, and fire fighters continue to extinguish the fire, still referring to its cause.

data.raw_text:
#WxHistory |
[🧵] We'll talk about two major typhoons that hit Luzon Philippines on this day. 

First, Typhoon Dot '85 (Saling) peaked as a C5 Super Typhoon. Its peak was 175mph (150kts) & a pressure of 897mb. Dot hammered the Philippines with potent force. Nueva Ecija Province had most of its buildings sustain damage from flooding & destructive winds. 

Dot hit Sanya, China where communications were lost. 

Overall, Dot killed 90 people. 
[1/2]
